description: Fusion ABO versioned Core Data Loader handoff over the 26.10 persisted-preflight route; public submission/status identity stays schema_version 1.0 for existing ESS consumers.

initialization.trigger: Only Entities exact HTTP 400 {Error: Could not find active meta model}, null response, null items or empty items. Other errors/malformed/nonempty missing-pair catalogs stop.
initialization.approval: Separate two-hour one-use parent Full preparation permission, then independent current Core preview approval on the same Core preflight. Preparation permission cannot submit.
initialization.recovery: Distinct adaptive-initialization checkpoint; either-stage intents/receipts block new submissions. Confirmed receipt status only; unknown intent is indeterminate, never replayed.
initialization.readiness: Explicit exact loader success, new pinned publish job success with exact echoed ID, then fresh catalog presence of ConsolidatedAsset and SerializedAsset. Presence not enabled state permits only a new Partial Publish proposal.
initialization.continuation: Fresh Partial Publish preparation and independent Core approval; existing enabled-entity and ESS gates remain unchanged. Standalone behavior unchanged.

data_loader_row.rule: Validate the embedded API contract and complete row before Core sample generation. Operation/header columns are not REST-body properties. Host checks all six values against Core validated workbook rows before approval; missing or incorrect values stop. Optional surrogate/reference fields are not business payload requirements.

privacy.rule: Parent/companion JSON shares opaque operation identity and non-executable business provenance. Core preview/receipt Markdown is relayed unchanged; private IDs are retained only in the companion operation checkpoint.

target_rules.fusion_host: HTTPS origin without credentials, path, query or fragment

workflow_provenance.rule: Exact v2 parent workflow and completed CPQ load plus business readbacks; provenance is not approval.

prepare_publish_load.side_effects: Read-only entity/concurrency checks and canonical workbook values; Core generates the workbook. One Core submission only after independent persisted-preview approval.

get_partial_publish_status.explicit_load_status: True only for an explicit user load-status request; pending stops. Default false never queries Data Loader.
get_partial_publish_status.job_monitoring: After exact verified load success, discover/pin new job distinct from baseline. Parent checks once, then offers keep checking every 15 seconds or check later. Repeated bounded exact-job reads require current explicit consent; check-later saves/stops; later status requests check once. Valid RUNNING/PENDING reads continue normally. A status_read_error is distinct from publish pending: stop immediately for auth/authorization failures after Core's single GET refresh attempt, or after three consecutive other read failures; save a resumable checkpoint for the same job. No Data Loader reads on job ticks.
get_partial_publish_status.monitoring_choice_owner: Fusion ABO parent; single-tick companion status and standalone behavior unchanged
get_partial_publish_status.ess_gate: Both monitoring paths require exact terminal success and enabled fixed entities, then separate exact-payload ESS approval. No ESS submission in this companion.

status_result.status_read_error: Optional sanitized diagnostic for a failed status GET: failure_stage, failure_class, observed_at, and optional HTTP status/provider_error. It does not change the publish state and never makes the operation eligible for ESS.
status_result.monitoring_read_failure_policy: The parent preserves the last read error and consecutive failure count. Authentication/authorization errors stop continuous monitoring immediately; other read errors stop after three consecutive failures. A successful read clears the count and error. Valid nonterminal publish responses continue under the existing bounded 15-second monitor.
status_result.ess_rule: eligible_for_ess only after exact terminal job success and final readiness of both fixed entities.

recovery.rule: Persist intent before upload. After possible submission use exact status/reconciliation; never automatically replay/reprepare. Changed or expired unsubmitted artifacts require fresh validation and approval.
recovery.legacy: Reject saved prepare/approve commands; identity-valid already-submitted v1 records are status-readable only.

loader_protocol.core_entry_point: core.data-loader workbook, persisted-preflight, submission and status handoffs
loader_protocol.workbook: Companion returns a versioned generate_workbook handoff with canonical values; Core returns the project-local workbook path and the companion checks exact handoff identity before continuing.
loader_protocol.preflight: Companion returns prepare_persisted_load for the confirmed workbook, business object, project, Run Book task and authentication reference. Core validates with --preflight-envelope-output and builds the Task Hook preview; the companion checks archive hash, task context and exact finalData before displaying approval.

structured_results.preflight: handoff_version, handoff_id, status=approval_required, source_path, preflight_path, task_validation, task_preview_path, core_approval_markdown
structured_results.submission: handoff_version, handoff_id, state=success, submission_started=true, content_id, request_id, markdown with the same IDs
structured_results.status: handoff_version, handoff_id, request_id, status=SUCCEEDED|PENDING|FAILED|INDETERMINATE, markdown and safe counts

loader_protocol.rules: Evaluate ordered Task Hook resources against the exact validated source, six mapped fields and current-stage evidence; no blanket pass.
loader_protocol.preview: Core creates the exact persisted Task Hook preview; build-load-preview accepts its bound structured result. Optional XLSX link precedes unchanged Core Markdown.
loader_protocol.approval: Later explicit contextual approval of the current preview digest; preparation permission cannot upload.
loader_protocol.submission: submit-data-load reserves intent and returns submit_approved_persisted_load; Core approves/verifies the archive and returns its taskValidationEnvelope unchanged, then submits the saved bytes through approved-preflight-envelope exactly once. complete-data-load accepts only a matching correlated Core receipt.
loader_protocol.status: An explicit user request returns a bound data_load_status handoff for the saved Request ID. The companion accepts only its matching structured Core result before any publish-job lookup.
loader_protocol.timeout: Core Task Hook preview expires after 30 minutes; preparation permission is a distinct two-hour one-use proposal.
loader_protocol.persistence: Existing Core immutable archive, preflight and Task Hook envelopes; no credentials or tokens.
